gen-dafont-disorder-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla draws wide, barely curled s shapes and keeps its ascenders a short hop from the midline. But Disorder is the one for raw shouting, with big lowercase and scattered glyphs, while Anek Bangla handles the talking.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-anek-malayalam: Raw and tube-straight, Disorder sprawls with its glyphs set far apart. Anek Malayalam follows with clean, low-contrast curves whose tips never touch, and capitals barely taller than the lowercase.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-blinker: Disorder shouts with spaced-out glyphs and a big lowercase, while Blinker holds its line thickness and keeps every aperture open. Rawness up top, easy legibility below: that gap is the whole appeal.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads contemporary and approachable, each curve ending in a clear opening and capitals barely taller than lowercase. Disorder shouts; the body text goes down easily, page after page.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte gives its lowercase e a wide-eyed look, with n arches matching the stems and a prominent x-height. Disorder supplies the uproar while the sans-serif text stays out of its way.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-fresca: Raw letters scattered wide, then a tidy line beneath. Disorder keeps its strokes bare and its lowercase big, while Fresca opens its counters outward and keeps its ascenders short.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans lets its stroke widths stay put from stem to curve, with ascender tops nearly level with the x-height line. Next to Disorder, text settles into a smooth, steady rhythm.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-geist: Clean and level, Geist hums along without a single accent of weight. Its generous openings group into solid word blocks, a quiet foil for Disorder with its raw, spread-out glyphs and oversized lowercase.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-hind-mysuru: Loud and loose up top, Disorder scatters big lowercase glyphs with gaps all around. And Hind Mysuru, a sans with ajar a shapes, reads in a smooth, unfussy stream.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-hind-siliguri: Raw and sprawling, Disorder sets big lowercase glyphs far apart with no swelling at the joins. Hind Siliguri, a sans with rounds like cracked bangles, hums along in a flat gray texture.
